objective: Complete one real Ark Runtime component run if Linux-native build inputs permit, with independent test feedback; otherwise document the exact build blocker.

workstreams.goal: Build the pinned Ark Runtime on Linux-native storage and run the existing typedarrayset case; perform a true fixed-source comparison only if an exact repair revision exists.
deliverables: actual test result or precise blocker
workstreams.stop_condition: One actual component result or one precise Linux-native build blocker; no repeated NTFS/P9 attempt.

workstreams.goal: Map official test assertions and semantics, independently verify source/fix provenance, then replay the exact developer runtime artifact and send discrepancies back.
workstreams.stop_condition: One independent replay and feedback, or one precise independent blocker; never substitute fixtures for a real fix.

feedback_loop: Tester sends official test expectations and any verified fixed ref to developer.
Developer runs against pinned source and shares immutable build/test artifacts.
Tester independently replays same artifact and reports concrete discrepancies.
Developer fixes only reproducible harness/connection defects and requests one focused retest.
evidence_policy: Missing exact repair revision remains unknown; fixtures do not replace version comparison.
Partial/blocked and candidate status are preserved; no product impact or accuracy claim without evidence.
